<script>
(function () {
  const routeButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-route-filter]")];
  const routeCards = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-route-level]")];
  routeButtons.forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const level = button.dataset.routeFilter;
    routeButtons.forEach((candidate) => candidate.classList.toggle("is-active", candidate === button));
    routeCards.forEach((card) => { card.hidden = level !== "all" && card.dataset.routeLevel !== level; });
  }));

  const projectCards = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-featured-project]")];
  const projectButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-project-switch]")];
  const showProject = (key) => {
    projectCards.forEach((card) => { card.hidden = card.dataset.featuredProject !== key; });
    projectButtons.forEach((button) => {
      const active = button.dataset.projectSwitch === key;
      button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
    });
  };
  projectButtons.forEach((button) => button.addEventListener("click", () => showProject(button.dataset.projectSwitch)));
  if (projectCards.length) showProject(Math.random() < 0.5 ? "stockpile" : "forecast");
})();
</script>
